a_priceBreakdown.evidence: Two money rows render above the commit button and both are in the DOM, not only in an i18n object. Line item 'Herrenschnitt' with 'CHF 45' at doc y 387, 14px weight 400. Then a rule (1px rgb(228,228,231), 10px padding-top, 10px margin-top) and the total row at doc y 418: label 'Total' 15px weight 600, amount 'CHF 45' 22px weight 700 Inter Tight, ink. The rendered total equals the rendered line item, so the PBV total-price rule is satisfied: nothing is added after the fact.
a_priceBreakdown.vat: No VAT row renders, and that is CORRECT here rather than missing. The floor says 'VAT where applicable'. PayConfirmStep.tsx:469 gates the row on salonVatRegistered, which reads salons.vat_registered. cuts-and-culture has vat_registered = false and vat_number = null, so no VAT is applicable and no row is due. A search of the rendered body text for MWST, Mehrwertsteuer, VAT, 'inkl.' and 'exkl.' returned nothing, which matches.
a_priceBreakdown.vatNotProvable: I could not measure the VAT row rendering, because 0 of the 28 seeded salons have vat_registered = true and I am read only. The render site exists at PayConfirmStep.tsx:469-473 and the row is real JSX, but this run is not evidence that it renders correctly with a registered salon.
a_priceBreakdown.surcharge: No surcharge line renders, and none is due: the cart holds one service at its list price and no staff or duration surcharge applies. Not evidence about how a surcharge would render.

b_cancellationTermAboveCommit.verdict: PASS on the letter of the floor, with a named caveat that is worth acting on
b_cancellationTermAboveCommit.evidence:
The term renders as real JSX at PayConfirmStep.tsx:707-712: a ShieldCheck icon in text-s-success beside a

. In the live DOM the text node reads 'Kostenlos bis 24h vorher stornieren.' at doc y 870, 12.5px, rgb(107,107,107), with the green icon at doc y 872, rgb(22,163,74). compareDocumentPosition puts it BEFORE the commit button in DOM order. This is NOT the walk-in-pay failure: that file defined cancelPolicy in four locale objects with zero JSX render sites, and this one has a render site with live text in it.
b_cancellationTermAboveCommit.caveat: At the measured viewport and at scrollY 0 the term sits at doc y 870, which is 26px below the 844px fold, while the commit button is pinned on screen at viewport y 776 at every scroll position. So the button is reachable before the term has ever been on screen. The document is 1081px tall against an 844px viewport, so 237px of scroll is available and the term does come into view at full scroll (viewport y 633, clear of the fixed bar). The floor's words are 'renders in the DOM above the commit button' and it does; the ordering is right and the visibility is not.
b_cancellationTermAboveCommit.secondCaveat: The rendered term states only the free half of the policy. The salon row carries late_cancel_fee_percent = 50, so cancelling inside 24 hours costs half the price, and no rendered string on this screen says so.

c_whoYouAreBookingWith.evidence: Salon name 'Cuts & Culture' renders at doc y 81, 15px weight 600 Inter Tight, with its cover photo 44x44 at radius 12 beside it and the address 'Elsässerstrasse 10, Basel' at doc y 106, 13px rgb(107,107,107). The stylist 'Jonas' renders at doc y 152, 15px weight 600, with a 45x45 round avatar. Both are above the commit button at viewport y 776 in position AND before it in DOM order, and both are inside the first viewport at scrollY 0, so unlike the cancellation term they cannot be missed. This is a salon and a person, not a category.

adjacentDefectFound._what: Not one of the three named conditions, recorded because it was measured on the same screen and it is a trust problem of the same family.
adjacentDefectFound.finding: The commit button label never says money is about to be taken. It reads 'Buchung bestätigen' with 'Jetzt online bezahlen' selected, and it still reads 'Buchung bestätigen' after tapping 'Zahlung im Salon'. Verified by reading the label before and after the tap.
adjacentDefectFound.cause: PayConfirmStep.tsx:725-731 keys the label on paymentMode, which line 161 derives from salons.payment_mode and which is 'at_salon' for this salon. The customer's own choice lives in a different variable, payChoice, which line 179 folds into paymentMethod. The label never reads payChoice, so the 'Weiter zur Zahlung CHF 45' branch is unreachable whenever the salon is at_salon, which is every seeded salon path that offers the online option at all.
